goal: Drop FTS content copies with contentless FTS5

summary.title: Drop FTS content copies with contentless FTS5
summary.what: messages_fts and sessions_fts are now contentless FTS5 (content='' + contentless_delete=1). The inverted index still stores tokenize() bigrams/words; tokenized text is no longer duplicated in *_fts_content. find snippets come from JOIN'd messages.content_text / session fields via makeRawSnippet instead of FTS5 snippet(). Existing DBs rebuild both FTS tables from already-stored rows on the next write/sync (batched, transactional) and VACUUM; transcript files are not re-parsed and message bodies are not truncated.
summary.why: On the 705MB local index, messages_fts_content (265MB) plus sessions_fts_content (22MB) were copies of tokenized text the query path never needed. Snippets and ranking already JOIN messages/sessions. int_96a8fc73 deferred this shrink; this is Bet 2 only — no sidecar metadata, no daemon.
summary.user_goal: Drop FTS content copies with contentless FTS5

decisions.point: How to stop storing tokenized FTS text twice
decisions.chose: contentless FTS5 with content='' and contentless_delete=1, keeping the same column list so INSERT/DELETE SQL stays put.
decisions.rationale: The index stores tokenize() output, not raw content_text, so content=messages would be wrong. contentless_delete lets existing DELETE FROM fts WHERE rowid=... keep working on SQLite 3.53.
rejected: Dropping UNINDEXED columns in the same change
Requiring a full JSONL re-parse to rebuild FTS

decisions.point: Where snippets come from after contentless FTS
decisions.chose: makeRawSnippet on JOIN'd messages.content_text, matching the session-hit path.
decisions.rationale: FTS5 snippet() cannot read contentless tables, and even before this it highlighted tokenized bigrams rather than original text.
rejected: Keeping snippet(messages_fts) behind a contentful table

decisions.chose: Detect non-contentless-delete FTS in ensureSchema on write open, DROP+rebuild from messages/sessions in 256-row batches inside a transaction, then VACUUM. Read-only commands keep using the old contentful FTS until that write.
decisions.rationale: openWriteDb already runs ensureSchema; sync is the product write path. Batching avoids better-sqlite3's one-query-at-a-time limit without loading 220MB of bodies at once.
rejected: Leaving the file size unvacuumed after DROP

rejected.reason: Out of scope; this change only removes FTS content copies.

rejected.alternative: A watcher/daemon to rebuild FTS in the background
rejected.reason: Violates the product boundary that Sherlog stays a CLI with manual incremental sync.

review_notes: Copy-migrated ~/.local/state/shlog/index.sqlite (not in place): 704.9MB -> 392.3MB in 26s; 360386 messages, FTS row count matched, longest body 302855 chars unchanged, no *_fts_content shadows.
Before dbstat: messages_fts_content 265MB, sessions_fts_content 22MB, messages 220MB. After: messages 219MB, messages_fts_data 101MB, no content tables.
find on the migrated copy still returns <mark> snippets from original text. Production index was not migrated.
Warm node dist/cli.js status --selector all: dbMs=10.6, real 0.07s (Bet 1 coverage proof still in the ~100ms class).
This branch also carries int_96a8fc73 (Bet 1 coverage proof) so 0.4.1 can ship both. This intent's files_touched are the Bet 2 FTS/schema/snippet set only.
Downgrading a CLI past this migrate will break find snippets because old snippet(messages_fts) cannot read contentless tables. First post-upgrade sync may take time and needs free disk for VACUUM.

architectural_claims: messages_fts and sessions_fts are contentless FTS5 indexes of tokenize() output; they do not store tokenized text copies.
FTS rebuild on schema migrate reads already-indexed messages/sessions rows and does not re-parse transcripts or truncate content_text.
find message snippets are generated from JOIN'd messages.content_text, not from FTS content columns or FTS5 snippet().
behavioral_changes: First write/sync after upgrade rebuilds FTS as contentless and VACUUMs; stderr logs when >=10000 messages.
find snippets highlight original message/session text rather than tokenized FTS content.
Read-only commands against a pre-migrate DB keep working until the write migrate runs.
migration_notes: Existing indexes migrate on the next openWriteDb (typically sync). Message bodies stay in messages.content_text. VACUUM needs roughly the post-migrate file size in free disk.
Do not migrate a production DB as an experiment; copy first. After migrate, older CLIs that call snippet(messages_fts) will fail until upgraded.
Global shlog remains the previous registry release until a normal npm publish.
